title: White-Label EV Charging Management Systems (CPMS)
seo_title: Enterprise White-Label EV Charging Software & Roaming Platforms
description: White-label EV charging management systems (CPMS) empower charge point operators (CPOs), energy utilities, and fleet service providers to deploy branded electric vehicle charging networks at scale. These enterprise SaaS platforms provide end-to-end infrastructure control, hardware-agnostic charger connectivity via OCPP 1.6J and OCPP 2.0.1, and turnkey driver-facing mobile applications for iOS and Android. A core capability of white-label CPMS platforms is multi-currency billing, tariff structuring, and automated driver expense reimbursement for depot, public, and home charging. Through Open Charge Point Interface (OCPI 2.2.1) protocols, these platforms support automated roaming across national charging networks, allowing commercial drivers to access third-party charging hubs using unified RFID cards or mobile credentials while centralizing billing for the enterprise fleet manager.
